faq.eyebrow: A few things you might wonder
faq.title: Your questions, answered

languages.question: Can I browse in Arabic or English?
languages.answer: Yes. Switch languages in the header at any time. We will remember your choice for your next visit.

sharing.question: How will I share my invitation?
sharing.answer: Once your invitation is published, you can send its link to your guests on WhatsApp.

subscription.question: Is this a monthly subscription?
subscription.answer: No. Each plan is a one-time payment for one event, with the online period shown above.

refund.question: Is there a refund window?
refund.answer: You can request a refund within 14 days of payment if your invitation is not published.

edits.question: How many edits are allowed?
edits.answer: It depends on the tier you choose. Premium offers up to 40 edits.

after.question: What happens after the event?
after.answer: Your invitation remains online for a grace period depending on the tier, then is automatically removed.
